item.title: Cabinet Reshuffle Botched from the Start, Sunk in the Yong Hye-in and Kim Seung-won Quagmire (첫 단추부터 잘못 꿴 개각, 용혜인·김승원 늪에 빠졌다)
item.description:
Cabinet Reshuffle Botched from the Start, Sunk in the Yong Hye-in and Kim Seung-won Quagmire (첫 단추부터 잘못 꿴 개각, 용혜인·김승원 늪에 빠졌다)

President Lee Jae-myung carried out a cabinet reshuffle aimed at national renewal and shifting the political landscape, but the political controversy is only intensifying. At the center are Yong Hye-in, nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, and Kim Seung-won, nominee for Minister of Justice. Allegations of preferential treatment, entitlement, and illegal lobbying against the two are spiraling out of control. (이재명 대통령이 국정 쇄신과 국면 전환을 위한 개각을 했지만 정치적 논란은 오히려 가열되고 있습니다. 용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자와 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자가 그 중심에 있습니다. 두 사람에 대한 각종 특혜·기득권·불법 청탁 의혹이 걷잡을 수 없이 커지는 상황입니다.)

Nominee Yong Hye-in is under heavy crossfire over allegations of preferential treatment and entitlement. Even within the ruling camp, criticism is emerging, with calls to "step down from her parliamentary seat" and claims that this is "an inappropriate appointment." Pro-government parties and women's and civic groups have demanded that she is "unfit to be Minister of Gender Equality and Family" and should "voluntarily resign." The opposition has attacked her, saying, "This is a family business and a family income party, where she appointed her husband and aides to party positions to siphon off government subsidies," "She shows greed in trying to have both the ministerial post and her parliamentary seat," and "She is the epitome of preferential treatment and entitlement that ordinary young people could never even dream of." (용혜인 후보자는 각종 특혜와 기득권 논란으로 십자포화를 맞고 있습니다. 여권 내부에서도 “의원직을 내려놓으라” “부적절한 인사”라는 비판이 나옵니다. 범여권 정당과 여성·시민단체들은 “성평등가족부 장관으로 적합하지 않다” “자진 사퇴하라”고 요구했습니다. 야당은 “남편·보좌진을 당직에 기용해 국고보조금을 타간 패밀리 비즈니스이자 가족소득당” “장관과 의원직까지 양손의 떡을 다 가지려는 탐욕” “일반 청년들은 꿈도 꿀 수 없는 특혜와 기득권의 대명사”라고 공격했습니다.)

Nominee Kim Seung-won is being criticized as a "minister appointed to drop the charges against the president." His suspended indictment two years ago for lobbying the head of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety regarding a pharmaceutical company is also highly controversial. The People Power Party has even released text messages exchanged between him and the food and drug safety chief, demanding his withdrawal. Text messages in which Kim expressed regret while explaining the case to the ruling party's Judiciary Committee chairman were also made public. The opposition is unleashing concentrated fire, saying, "Kim Seung-won is the top priority for voluntary withdrawal." (김승원 후보자는 ‘대통령 사건 공소취소용 장관’이라는 비판을 받고 있습니다. 2년 전 식약처장에게 제약회사 관련 청탁을 한 혐의로 기소유예된 것도 논란이 큽니다. 국민의힘은 김 후보자가 식약처장과 주고받은 청탁 문자까지 공개하며 사퇴를 요구했습니다. 김 후보자가 여당 법사위원장에게 사건 경위를 설명하면서 ‘송구스럽다’고 한 문자 내용도 공개됐습니다. 야당은 “자진 사퇴 0순위는 김 후보자”라며 집중 포화를 퍼붓고 있습니다.)

The Democratic Party has said it will wrap up the confirmation hearing process before Chuseok. Within some pro-Myung factions, there is talk that "even if Yong is sacrificed, Kim must be protected at all costs." However, the People Power Party says, "The ruling camp's real intention is to appoint Kim Seung-won by using Yong Hye-in as a sacrificial lamb and decoy," adding, "That exposed strategy will no longer work." They have signaled intense scrutiny and a fierce offensive against both nominees during the confirmation hearings. (민주당은 추석 전에 인사 청문 정국을 끝내겠다고 했습니다. 친명 일각에선 “용 후보자는 희생시키더라도 김 후보자는 반드시 지켜야 한다”는 말이 나옵니다. 하지만 국힘은 “용혜인을 희생타이자 미끼로 김승원을 임명하겠다는 게 여권의 속셈”이라며 “탄로 난 전략은 더 이상 통하지 않을 것”이라고 합니다. 청문회에서 용·김 두 후보자에 대한 송곳 검증과 집중 공세를 예고한 것입니다.)

The belated resignation of former Cheong Wa Dae policy chief Kim Yong-beom two days after the reshuffle is also causing controversy. Questions are being raised about whether the administration, initially planning to replace only the ministers of economy, land, and SMEs while keeping Kim in place, was forced to dismiss him under mounting criticism. (김용범 전 청와대 정책실장이 개각 이틀 후 뒤늦게 사퇴한 것도 논란을 빚고 있습니다. 김 전 실장을 뺀 채 재경부·국토부·중소벤처기업부 장관만 교체하려다 비판 여론에 밀려 어쩔 수 없이 김 전 실장을 경질한 것 아니냐는 것입니다.)

Within the ruling camp, there is regret: "If Kim had been replaced at the same time as the reshuffle, expectations for renewal and policy shifts would have soared, but forcing him out late under public pressure has halved the effect." The late change has effectively erased the impact of the renewal. (여권 내부에선 “개각과 동시에 김 전 실장을 교체했으면 쇄신과 정책 전환 기대감이 높아졌을 텐데 뒤늦게 여론에 떠밀려 사퇴시키는 바람에 효과가 반감됐다”며 아쉬워 합니다. 뒷북 교체로 인해 쇄신 효과가 사실상 사라졌다는 것입니다.)

In political circles, there is a consensus that President Lee botched the first button of his personnel renewal through the reshuffle. The hoped-for shift in momentum has vanished, and only the Yong Hye-in and Kim Seung-won controversies have grown. There are serious concerns that "if they fall into the Yong Hye-in and Kim Seung-won quagmire, recovering the approval ratings of the party and the administration will become even harder." (정치권에선 이 대통령이 개각을 통한 인적 쇄신의 첫 단추를 잘못 꿰었다는 평가가 나옵니다. 국면 전환 효과는 사라지고 용혜인과 김승원 논란만 커졌다는 것입니다. “용혜인·김승원 늪에 빠지면 당·청 지지율 회복은 더 힘들어질 수 있다”는 우려도 큽니다.)

Nominee Yong Hye-in secured a proportional representative seat twice through the Democratic Party's "pro-government satellite proportional party" scheme under the Basic Income Party. This is unprecedented. Criticism has arisen that she received privileges ordinary young people could never aspire to, in line with President Lee's flagship policy code of "basic income." (용혜인 후보자는 민주당의 ‘범여 위성 비례 정당’ 꼼수를 통해 기본소득당으로 두 번이나 비례대표 배지를 달았습니다. 전례가 없는 일입니다. 이 대통령이 핵심 정책으로 내세운 ‘기본소득’ 코드에 맞춰 일반 청년들은 감히 넘볼 수 없는 특혜를 받았다는 비판이 나옵니다.)

After being nominated as minister, she refused to resign her proportional representative seat, breaking the long-standing convention that proportional representatives step down upon becoming ministers. Criticism poured in that "she holds both the ministerial post and her parliamentary seat like rice cakes in each hand and refuses to let go of either," and that "she is trying to enjoy triple or quadruple privileges." (그는 장관에 지명된 후 비례대표 의원직 사퇴를 거부했습니다. 그동안 비례대표가 장관에 오르면 사퇴하던 관행을 거스른 것입니다. “양손에 장관과 의원직이란 떡을 든 채 둘 다 내려놓지 않겠다는 것” “3중 4중 특혜를 누리려 한다”는 비판이 쏟아졌습니다.)

The fact that Yong's husband served as a key executive of the Basic Income Party is also controversial. Records show that only Yong and her husband attended the party's first meeting held three days after its founding. At that meeting, Yong appointed her husband as secretary-general, responsible for running the party. Her husband subsequently held various core party positions and received around 3 million won per month. In effect, government subsidies to the Basic Income Party ended up going to Yong's husband. He is currently running as a candidate for the party's supreme council member. (용 후보자 남편이 기본소득당 핵심 당직자를 지낸 것도 논란입니다. 창당 사흘 후 처음 열린 당 회의에는 용 후보자 부부만 참석한 것으로 기록돼 있습니다. 여기서 용 후보자는 남편을 당 살림을 책임지는 사무총장에 임명했습니다. 남편은 이후 당의 핵심 보직을 두루 맡았고 매달 300만원가량을 받았습니다. 기본소득당에 대한 국고 보조금이 결국 용 후보자 남편에게 지급된 셈입니다. 그는 현재 기본소득당 최고위원 후보로 출마한 상태입니다.)

Most of Yong's National Assembly aides are also former executives or regional chapter heads of the Basic Income Party. There is speculation that her refusal to resign her parliamentary seat is because "if the party loses its parliamentary presence, it would lose government subsidies." She inevitably faces criticism that this is "essentially a family business" and a "family income party." Yong's use of the airport VIP lounge during a family trip and her short-term real estate flipping have also come under scrutiny. (용 후보자의 국회 보좌진도 대부분 기본소득당 당직자나 지역위원장 출신입니다. 용 후보자가 의원직 사퇴를 거부하는 이유도 “원외 정당이 되면 국고보조금을 받지 못하니까 그런 것 아니냐”는 해석이 나옵니다. “사실상 패밀리 비즈니스” “가족소득당”이란 비판을 받을 수밖에 없습니다. 용 후보자가 가족 여행 때 공항 의전실을 이용한 것과 부동산 단타 매매를 한 것도 도마에 올랐습니다.)

Yong, battered from all sides by both ruling and opposition parties from the moment of her nomination, was left in a state of collapse within three days. Even within the ruling camp, calls for her to "resign her parliamentary seat" and "voluntarily withdraw" are being raised. Democratic Party Supreme Council member Park Sun-won and lawmaker Lee Kwang-jae said, "It is right for her to resign her seat," while lawmaker Song Young-gil remarked, "Is it fair that she rose like lightning and received double and triple privileges?" adding, "Public sentiment will find it hard to accept." Song reportedly suggested, in a metaphor about crossing a river infested with crocodiles on a raft, that Yong could be abandoned. (지명되는 순간부터 여야로부터 난타를 당한 용 후보자는 사흘만에 그로기 상태에 몰렸습니다. 여권 내부에서도 ‘의원직 사퇴’ 요구와 ‘자진 사퇴론’이 제기되고 있습니다. 민주당 박선원 최고위원과 이광재 의원은 “의원직을 사퇴하는 게 옳다”고 했고, 송영길 의원은 “벼락 출세하고 이중 삼중 특혜를 받은 것이 과연 공정한가”라며 “민심이 수용하기 쉽지 않을 것”이라고 했습니다. 송 의원은 악어가 사는 강을 건너는 누떼에 비유해 용 후보자를 버리고 갈 수 있다는 취지로 말했습니다.)

Progressive parties such as the Justice Party and the Progressive Party also unanimously demanded Yong's withdrawal. Women's and civic groups did the same, arguing that supporting the abolition of supplementary investigation powers while turning their backs on the demands of women and the vulnerable makes her unqualified to be Minister of Gender Equality and Family. (정의당과 진보당 등 진보 정당들도 일제히 용 후보자 사퇴를 요구했습니다. 여성·시민단체들도 마찬가지입니다. 여성과 약자들의 요구를 저버린 채 보완 수사권 폐지에 찬성한 것은 성평등가족부 장관 자격이 없다고 했습니다.)

The opposition asked, "Isn't she a bulletproof shield and decoy to protect Kim Seung-won?" In response, the presidential office said, "She should be given a chance to explain herself." Yong stated, "I will listen carefully to various opinions." This resembles the case of former minister Lee Hye-hoon. In Yeouido, predictions are already circulating that "Yong Hye-in will become a discarded card." (야당은 “김승원 법무장관 후보자를 보호하기 위한 총알받이와 미끼 아니냐”고 했습니다. 이에 대해 청와대는 “소명할 기회를 줘야 한다”고 했습니다. 용 후보자는 “여러 의견을 경청하겠다”고 했습니다. 이혜훈 전 장관 때와 유사합니다. 여의도에선 벌써부터 “용혜인은 버리는 카드가 될 것”이란 전망이 나옵니다.)

The People Power Party has identified Kim Seung-won as its real target. If Yong Hye-in is a preliminary bout in this personnel war, the real battlefield and main event is Kim Seung-won. (국민의힘은 진짜 타깃으로 김승원 후보자를 지목했습니다. 용혜인이 이번 인사 전쟁의 예선전 성격이라면, 진짜 전쟁터이자 본선은 김승원이라는 것입니다.)

The reason both ruling and opposition parties have entered a life-or-death struggle over Kim is that the next Minister of Justice holds the key to the president's top priority: dropping the charges against him. His predecessor, Minister Jung Sung-ho, stepped down without resolving the issue. The opposition's view is that President Lee then chose Kim as the person most likely to aggressively pursue the dismissal of the indictment. Kim previously led the Democratic Party's caucus on dropping charges and proposed a special counsel bill on the alleged fabricated indictment. (여야가 김 후보자를 놓고 사활을 건 싸움에 들어간 것은 차기 법무장관이 이 대통령의 최고 관심사인 공소 취소의 키를 쥐고 있기 때문입니다. 전임인 정성호 장관은 이 문제를 해결하지 않고 스스로 물러났습니다. 그러자 이 대통령이 공소 취소를 가장 적극 추진할 인물로 김 후보자를 선택했다는 것이 야당의 시각입니다. 그는 민주당 공소 취소 모임 대표를 지냈고 조작 기소 특검법도 발의했습니다.)

The ruling party is in a mood of "Kim must be appointed no matter what." As the central figure of this reshuffle, they intend to push him through the confirmation hearing and have him appointed before Chuseok. The opposition, meanwhile, has vowed to block him at all costs, calling him "top priority for nomination withdrawal as a minister for dropping charges." Both sides have entered an uncompromising war of confirmation scrutiny. (여당은 “김 후보자를 반드시 임명시킨다”는 기류입니다. 이번 인사의 핵심 인물인 만큼 반드시 청문회를 통과시키고 추석 전에 임명토록 하겠다는 겁니다. 반면 야당은 “공소 취소용 장관으로 지명 철회 0순위”라며 결사 저지에 나섰습니다. 양측 모두 한 치 양보 없는 청문 검증 전쟁에 들어간 것입니다.)

Round one of the Kim Seung-won war is the pharmaceutical company lobbying case from two years ago. In 2024, Kim received a suspended indictment for lobbying the food and drug safety chief on behalf of a pharmaceutical company developing COVID-19 treatments. At the time, a broker relayed the company's lobbying requests to Kim, who forwarded them to the food and drug safety chief. The request was to expedite approval of the company's clinical trial plan for a COVID-19 treatment, and the chief promptly replied, "I'll take care of it." Indeed, two weeks later, the agency approved the company's clinical plan. (김승원 전쟁 1라운드는 2년 전 있었던 제약회사 로비 사건입니다. 김 후보자는 2024년 코로나 치료제 개발 제약회사와 관련한 로비를 받아 식약처장에게 청탁한 혐의로 기소유예 처분을 받았습니다. 김 후보자는 당시 브로커로부터 제약회사 측 로비 내용을 전달받아 식약처장에게 보냈습니다. 이 회사가 코로나 치료제 임상시험 계획 승인을 빨리 받을 수 있도록 해달라는 부탁이었고, 식약처장은 곧바로 “잘 챙기겠다”고 답했습니다. 실제로 식약처는 2주 후 이 회사 임상 계획을 승인했습니다.)

In response, the broker said the pharmaceutical company would make a donation as a token of gratitude, and Kim thanked him and provided his account number. The company deposited 5 million won, but since Kim's donation limit was already maxed out, the deposit was not actually completed. (그러자 브로커는 제약회사 측에서 감사의 뜻으로 후원금을 넣겠다고 했고 김 후보자는 고맙다며 계좌 번호를 알려줬습니다. 제약회사 측이 500만원을 입금했지만, 김 후보자의 후원금 한도가 꽉 차 실제 입금은 되지 않았습니다.)

Kim explained the case to Judiciary Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo via text, expressing regret. As controversy grew, the People Power Party demanded his voluntary withdrawal, saying, "Someone who engaged in improper lobbying cannot become Minister of Justice." They also announced intense scrutiny and a high-pressure confirmation hearing for Kim. The confirmation hearing is likely to be dominated by battles over Kim Seung-won throughout, serving as a preliminary skirmish for the upcoming controversy over dropping charges against the president. (김 후보자는 서영교 법사위원장에게 사건 경위를 설명하면서 ‘송구스럽다’는 문자를 보냈습니다. 논란이 커지자 국민의힘은 “부정 청탁을 한 사람이 법무장관이 될 수는 없다”며 자진 사퇴를 요구했습니다. 김 후보자에 대한 송곳 검증과 고강도 청문회도 예고했습니다. 국회 청문회 기간 내내 김승원 공방이 이어질 가능성이 큽니다. 향후 이어질 대통령 공소 취소 논란의 전초전이기도 합니다.)

The Democratic Party has said it will finish the confirmation hearing process before Chuseok, aiming to quickly set up its lineup and push through budget and legislation in the regular session. But that will not be easy. (민주당은 추석 전에 인사 청문 정국을 끝내겠다고 했습니다. 빨리 진용을 갖춰 정기 국회에서 예산·입법을 밀어붙이겠다는 것입니다. 하지만 쉬운 일이 아닙니다.)

The National Assembly committees handling the confirmation hearings for Hong Ji-sun, nominee for Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport—a connection from President Lee's Gyeonggi Province network—and Yong Hye-in are both chaired by the opposition. Even if the ruling party rushes, processing before Chuseok will be difficult if the opposition refuses. (이 대통령의 경기도 인맥인 홍지선 국토교통부 장관 후보자와 용혜인 후보자의 인사청문회가 열리는 국토위와 성평등가족위는 야당이 위원장입니다. 여당이 서둘러도 야당이 거부하면 추석 전 처리는 힘듭니다.)

In the Judiciary Committee, chaired by the ruling party, there is a push to finish Kim Seung-won's confirmation hearing quickly. The appointment of pro-Myung lawmaker Kim Eui-kyum as the committee's secretary despite various controversies appears to be preparation for this. Some speculate that Kim could be appointed before the abolition of the prosecution service and the launch of the new public prosecution office on October 2, to begin preparations for dropping the charges. However, if allegations such as the pharmaceutical lobbying case grow and public criticism mounts, the ruling camp could find itself in an awkward position. (여당이 위원장인 법사위에선 김승원 후보자 청문회를 속전속결로 끝내겠다는 기류입니다. 친명인 김의겸 의원을 각종 논란에도 법사위 간사에 임명한 것은 그 준비 작업으로 보입니다. 일각에선 10월 2일 검찰청 폐지와 공소청 출범 전에 김 후보자를 임명해서 공소 취소 준비 작업을 하려는 것 아니냐는 관측도 나옵니다. 하지만 제약회사 로비 등 각종 의혹이 커지고 비판 여론이 커지면 여권으로선 곤혹스러운 상황에 빠질 수 있습니다.)

The belated resignation of former policy chief Kim Yong-beom two days after the reshuffle has also generated considerable gossip. On the morning of the 30th, Kim had indicated he would appear at the National Assembly, suggesting he would remain in his post. But the tide shifted sharply in the afternoon, and he submitted his resignation. He took responsibility for the ETF leverage and real estate failures. Worsening public sentiment and ruling party backlash appear to have combined to force his hand. (김용범 전 청와대 정책실장이 개각 이틀 뒤 뒤늦게 사퇴한 것을 두고도 뒷말이 많습니다. 김 전 실장은 30일 오전만 해도 국회 출석 의사를 밝히는 등 유임 분위기였습니다. 그런데 오후부터 기류가 급변하면서 사표를 냈습니다. ETF 레버리지와 부동산 실패 책임을 진 건데요. 여론 악화와 여당 반발이 복합적으로 작용한 것 같습니다.)

Representative Kim Min-seok and the core pro-Myung leadership had long raised strong objections to the real estate policy and called for Kim Yong-beom to take responsibility. It is understood that as criticism grew over the economic team reshuffle—asking why "the main body, Kim Yong-beom, was left untouched"—they repeatedly demanded that President Lee replace him. Ultimately, Lee accepted and decided on his dismissal in the form of Kim's voluntary resignation. Lee's substantial rollback of the real estate tax proposals, with remarks that "government proposals are not always right," is also seen as fallout from Kim's ouster. (김민석 대표와 친명 핵심부는 그동안 부동산 정책 철회와 김용범 책임론을 강하게 제기해 왔는데요. 경제팀 물갈이에도 “몸통인 김용범은 왜 놔두냐”는 비판 여론이 커지자 이 대통령에게 재차 김 전 실장 교체를 요구한 것으로 알려졌습니다. 결국 이 대통령이 이를 받아들여 자신 사퇴 형식으로 교체를 결정했다는 후문입니다. 이 대통령이 “정부안이 항상 옳은 건 아니다”라며 부동산 세제안을 상당 부분 철회한 것도 김 실장 경질의 여파로 보입니다.)

Many assess this reshuffle as "botched from the first button." The backlash over Yong Hye-in is overwhelming. The timing of former chief Kim Yong-beom's resignation is also regrettable—had he stepped down simultaneously with the reshuffle, expectations for policy shifts through accountability would have risen, but his late departure only fueled more controversy. Even within the Democratic Party, there are assessments that the effects of shifting the momentum and recovering approval ratings have not matched expectations. (이 대통령의 이번 개각 인사를 두고 “첫 단추부터 잘못 꿰었다”는 평가가 많습니다. 우선 용혜인 역풍이 너무 큽니다. 김용범 전 실장 사퇴 타이밍도 아쉬운데요. 개각과 동시에 사퇴했으면 책임자 교체에 따른 정책 전환 기대감을 높였을 텐데, 뒤늦게 사퇴하면서 오히려 논란만 키웠습니다. 민주당에서도 국면 전환과 지지율 회복 효과가 기대만큼 크지 않다는 평가가 나옵니다.)

The ruling camp is likely to try to save Kim Seung-won by sacrificing Yong Hye-in. But the opposition is signaling it will go all-in on attacking Kim. Additional personnel moves, including the heads of the new public prosecution and anti-corruption offices and Supreme Court justices, could follow this month. The regular session is highly likely to become a battlefield of personnel wars. item.title: Yong Hye-in Stays Silent When Asked About Party Subsidies... Progressive Youth Appear and Protest (용혜인, 정당보조금 묻자 침묵... 진보성향 청년들 나와 시위)
item.description:
Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, on the 3rd repeated her stance regarding calls from both ruling and opposition parties to resign her proportional representative parliamentary seat, saying, “I will address this in detail during the confirmation hearing.” (용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자는 3일 여야에서 나오는 비례대표 의원직 사퇴 요구와 관련해 “인사청문회에서 상세히 말씀드리겠다”는 입장을 반복했다.)

The nominee made these remarks while meeting reporters on her way to work at the confirmation hearing preparation office set up at the Korea Youth Activity Promotion Agency in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. (용 후보자는 이날 서울 서대문구 한국청소년활동진흥원에 마련된 인사청문회 준비 사무실로 출근하는 길에 취재진과 만나 이같이 답했다.)

She did not respond to questions such as “Aren’t you placing a burden on the Lee Jae-myung administration?” and “Is it true that not stepping down from your parliamentary seat is because of state subsidies for political parties?” (그는 ‘이재명 정부에 부담을 주는 것 아니냐’ ‘의원직을 내려놓지 않는 것이 정당 국고보조금 때문인 것이 맞느냐’ 등 질문에는 답하지 않았다.)

The previous day, the nominee had said, “There are various opinions on this matter, and I am also listening carefully to the many worries and concerns.” (용 후보자는 전날에는 “이 부분은 여러 의견이 있고, 많은 걱정과 우려가 있음을 저도 경청하고 있다”고 했다.)

Calls for Yong to resign her parliamentary seat upon being appointed minister are also continuing from the ruling camp. Kim Jun-hyung, floor leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, said at the party’s supreme council meeting that day, “Please make a decision that the public can accept,” adding, “The longer the controversy drags on, the more the government’s intention to revitalize its governing momentum through a cabinet reshuffle becomes tarnished.” (용 후보자가 장관으로 임명되면 의원직을 사퇴해야 한다는 요구는 여권에서도 이어지고 있다. 김준형 조국혁신당 원내대표는 이날 당 최고위원회의에서 “국민이 납득할 수 있는 판단을 내려달라”며 “논란이 길어질수록 개각을 통해 국정 동력을 새롭게 하려는 정부의 뜻이 퇴색한다”고 했다.)

Kim Min-seok, co-chair of the Democratic Party of Korea, appeared on the party’s official YouTube channel and said regarding the controversy surrounding nominee Yong, “We are listening to the many concerns and criticisms and thinking deeply about them.” (김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 당 공식 유튜브에 출연해 용 후보자 논란에 대해 “많은 우려와 비판을 듣고 깊이 생각하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, at the scene that day, members of the progressive youth party ‘Future Party’ appeared and demanded her resignation from her parliamentary seat, saying, “1.5 million young people are struggling without jobs, and holding a dual position to protect the party’s interests is absurd.” (한편 이날 이 자리에는 진보 성향 청년 정당 ‘미래당’ 당원들이 나와 “150만 청년이 일자리도 없이 힘들게 지내고 있는데 당의 이익을 지키기 위해 겸직하는 것은 말도 안 된다”며 의원직 사퇴를 요구하기도 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok "Merger with Jo Kuk Innovation Party Undecided" Jo Kuk Party "Kim Min-seok Obsessed with Size Over Values" (김민석 “조국혁신당과 합당은 미정” 조국당 “김민석, 가치보다 덩치 집착”)
item.description:
The fallout continues from Jo Kuk, director of the Jo Kuk Innovation Party's Innovation Policy Research Institute, who said on the 1st, targeting the Democratic Party of Korea's "special counsel law for manipulated indictments," that "if you push for the withdrawal of President Lee Jae-myung's indictment, you could face political and legal setbacks." Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party, sent a warning message to the Jo Kuk Innovation Party on the 3rd, stating, "It would be wise to be cautious with remarks that undermine solidarity." Shin Jang-sik, leader of the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, said, "I'm not sure whether (the Democratic Party) approaching with a strange frame is truly in the best interest of President Lee Jae-myung." <<> Director Jo posted on Facebook on the 1st, pointing out, "If a prosecutor withdraws an indictment, the indictment does not automatically disappear; rather, the court must issue a dismissal ruling for the trial to conclude." He also said, "To withdraw the indictment on grounds of a manipulated indictment, the manipulated indictment must be confirmed." He added, "If you push for the withdrawal of President Lee's indictment while ignoring these points, you will inevitably face political and legal setbacks." This came just two days after President Lee appointed former Jo Kuk Innovation Party lawmaker Lee Hae-min as senior secretary for AI future planning at the presidential office. <<> Leader Kim appeared on the Democratic Party's YouTube channel "Democratic Party TV" on the morning of the 3rd and said regarding the issue of merger and solidarity with the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, "It would be wise to be cautious with remarks that undermine solidarity." This was interpreted as targeting Director Jo. The previous day, Park Sun-won, a supreme council member of the Democratic Party close to Lee, had also said, "That cannot be the language of a comrade. It is ingratitude." <<> Leader Kim said, "(Regarding the merger and solidarity with the Jo Kuk Innovation Party) everything is open, but solidarity is unconditional, while whether to merge is completely undecided." He also said, "We've opened a channel, so let's start dialogue, and whether to merge can be discussed and decided by both parties." This reaffirmed that a merger might not happen. <<> Around the same time, Representative Shin appeared on CBS Radio's "Park Sung-tae's News Show" and pushed back against the Democratic Party's backlash over Director Jo's remarks, saying they are "approaching with a strange frame." Shin said, "(Director Jo's remarks mean that) by establishing the facts (of the manipulated indictment) and building up sufficiently, the public's acceptance is more likely," adding, "I'm not sure whether approaching this as if (they were) offering a ritual prayer for President Lee to be convicted is truly the way to serve him." <<> Regarding Leader Kim's stated plans for solidarity and integration with the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, Representative Shin said, "It seems Leader Kim thinks that if you just grow in size rather than values, things will work out," adding, "You cannot succeed with size-building that lacks clear values." <<> Representative Shin said, "If values are not clear, you'll be deluded," asking, "If you scoop a few bowls of water from someone else's well, does that make it your well? No." This was a critique of the centrist expansion strategy of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party. Shin added, "Scooping a few bowls of water will not create a structural majority." (조국 조국혁신당 혁신정책연구원장이 지난 1일 더불어민주당의 ‘조작 기소 특검법’을 겨냥해 “이재명 대통령 공소 취소를 밀어붙이면 정치적·법적으로 낭패를 볼 수 있다”고 한 말의 파장이 계속되고 있다. 김민석 민주당 대표는 3일 “연대를 저해하는 언급은 조심하는 것이 좋겠다”며 조국혁신당에 경고의 메시지를 보냈다. 신장식 조국혁신당 대표는 “(민주당이) 이상한 프레임으로 접근하는 것이 진짜로 이재명 대통령을 위하는 길인지 모르겠다”고 했다.)
